# BulletChart

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Compact KPI bullet chart with qualitative background bands, primary measure bar, and target marker.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`. Extends `ChartBase`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new BulletChart(options?: BulletChartOptions)
```

## Properties

- [`label`](#label): Metric label drawn beside the bullet bar.
- [`maxValue`](#maxvalue): Optional explicit maximum scale value; inferred from data and ranges when omitted.
- [`measureColor`](#measurecolor): Fill colour of the primary measure bar.
- [`minValue`](#minvalue): Minimum scale value (default 0).
- [`orientation`](#orientation): Bar orientation (`Horizontal` default or `Vertical`).
- [`ranges`](#ranges): Qualitative background bands ordered from lower to upper thresholds.
- [`showScale`](#showscale): Whether to draw numeric scale ticks beneath or beside the bar.
- [`showValueLabel`](#showvaluelabel): Whether to draw the formatted value label beside the bar.
- [`target`](#target): Optional comparative target value drawn as a perpendicular marker.
- [`targetColor`](#targetcolor): Fill colour of the comparative target marker.
- [`value`](#value): Primary measured KPI value.
- [`valueFormat`](#valueformat): Number format for scale and value labels.
- [`valuePrefix`](#valueprefix): Prefix prepended to formatted values.
- [`valueSuffix`](#valuesuffix): Suffix appended to formatted values.

### `label`

```typescript
label: string
```

Metric label drawn beside the bullet bar.

Example, from `code-recipes/comparison-charts/bullet-chart`:

```typescript
b1.label = 'Revenue (£k)';
```

Example, from `code-recipes/comparison-charts/bullet-chart`:

```typescript
b2.label = 'Gross Margin';
```

### `ranges`

```typescript
ranges: readonly BulletRange[]
```

Qualitative background bands ordered from lower to upper thresholds.

> A read-only list: read it or loop over it, but it has no `add` or `push`.

Example, from `code-recipes/comparison-charts/bullet-chart`:

```typescript
b3.ranges = [{ max: 30 }, { max: 55 }, { max: 80 }];
```

Example, from `code-recipes/comparison-charts/bullet-chart`:

```typescript
b2.ranges = [{ max: 50 }, { max: 75 }, { max: 100 }];
```
